# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection in this context alters the sign of just one pion field, leading to a relative phase definition that differs by π compared to references [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is derived by reversing the sign of all three pion fields.
- The definition applied in this study facilitates a more intuitive comparison with the analogous scenario for monopoles, as outlined in equation (3.10).
- The profile function reaches zero at a radius of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, enabling a continuous connection between the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion, with fields matching the vacuum outside their cores.
- Beyond the initial conditions based on the simple ansatz (3.7), more advanced initial conditions were employed using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
